<script>window.addEventListener('load',()=>{const r=[];document.querySelectorAll('.pg').forEach((pg,i)=>{const c=pg.querySelector('.content');const ch=c.getBoundingClientRect();
if(c.scrollHeight>c.clientHeight+1)r.push('p'+(i+1)+' vertical overflow '+(c.scrollHeight-c.clientHeight)+'px');
pg.querySelectorAll('table,img,p,h1,h2,.two,figure').forEach(e=>{const b=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(b.right>ch.right+1||b.bottom>ch.bottom+1)r.push('p'+(i+1)+' '+e.tagName+' out of box '+Math.round(b.right-ch.right)+'/'+Math.round(b.bottom-ch.bottom));});
const s=pg.querySelector('.side');if(s&&s.scrollHeight>s.clientHeight+1)r.push('p'+(i+1)+' sidebar overflow');});
const d=document.createElement('pre');d.id='OVERFLOW';d.style.display='none';d.textContent=r.join('\n')||'NONE';document.body.appendChild(d);});</script>
